text:
Ah, a fresh start! Like a dog returning to its vomit, but with slightly less shame, eh? 

Listen closely, friend, for the Jester's wisdom is rarely found in fortune cookies. 

First, embrace the chaos! Life's a stage, and you're the clumsy clown juggling flaming torches. Expect to drop them, set your pants on fire, and trip over your own feet. Laugh at the absurdity of it all, for what else can you do?

Second, don't be afraid to wear a ridiculous hat.

Metaphorically speaking, of course. Unless you find a truly spectacular hat, then wear it with pride.

But seriously, be bold, be different, be the polka-dotted elephant in a room full of beige hamsters!

Third, remember, every ending is a beginning. Just like every joke has a punchline, every chapter closes with the promise of a new one. So chin up, dear friend, and remember: even if you fall flat on your face, at least you'll be the most entertaining corpse in the cemetery!

Now, if you'll excuse me, I must go juggle some existential dread and a rubber chicken. Farewell, and good luck!
